record._status: BUILT, NOT PUBLISHED. Resolves the two-convention split that propertySurfaceRepair2026_08_26 created.
record._window: Renames are safe now because the library has no consuming files. After a consuming file exists, renaming breaks every instance and every Code Connect mapping.

rule.categoryA: Mirrors a code prop -> code's exact name and values, lowercase. The casing IS the signal that a code prop stands behind it and can be diffed.
rule.categoryB: Exists only in Figma -> Sentence case. States, content slots, drawing affordances.
rule.doNotBlur: Never lowercase a Figma-only affordance; it falsely claims a code prop exists.

renamed.Button group/Segment: Color->color, Size->size. Position left Sentence (CSS sibling concern)
renamed.Snackbar content: Type->type, AND value Default->info. 'Default' was never a code value: SnackbarContentOverrides reads ownerState.type and the else branch is info.dark; the story's argTypes are ['info','success'].
renamed.Paper: Square->square (no/yes). Variant left alone - restructure, see below
renamed.Dialog: CORRECTED FROM THE PREVIOUS PASS - Figma-only slots were wrongly lowercase: DialogTitle->Show title, DialogActions->Show actions, secondAction->Show second action, action1->Action 1, action2->Action 2. maxWidth and fullScreen stay lowercase (Category A).
renamed.Menu: CORRECTED - item1..4->Item 1..4, showItem2..4->Show item 2..4. elevation stays lowercase.

leftAloneAndWhy.State (every component): Category B by rule. Hover, Focus visible, Focused are CSS pseudo-states, not props. disabled was NOT split out of State this pass.
leftAloneAndWhy.Position (Button group/Segment): CSS sibling concern, no code prop.
leftAloneAndWhy.Lines (List/Item): Derived from whether secondary text is present, not a prop.
leftAloneAndWhy.Value (Text field, Autocomplete/Field): Empty/Filled/Multiple describes presence of a value, not the value prop's accepted set.
leftAloneAndWhy.Clamp + State (Read more): VERIFIED IN SOURCE: ReadMore takes $maxLines and $maxCharacters as separate transient props and holds collapsed state in useState. Clamp abstracts two props; neither is a single code prop. Category B.
leftAloneAndWhy.Size + State (Split button): No design-system implementation exists - the only SplitButton is local to appointment-workflow-ui. No code component to mirror, so no Category A claim can be made. Left Sentence case.
leftAloneAndWhy.Content (Avatar): Fallback/Letter/Icon is a drawing affordance; MUI Avatar has no content prop.
leftAloneAndWhy.Variant + Container (Feedback message): Variant selects among six first-party components (NoResultsMessage etc.), not a variant prop.
leftAloneAndWhy.Actions (Card): Figma affordance for showing CardActions, not a prop.

valuesThatDoNotLineUp.where: Checkbox/Radio/Switch checked, Toggle button selected, Tabs/Tab selected, Accordion expanded, Paper square, Card Actions
valuesThatDoNotLineUp.detail: The code props are BOOLEAN. Figma variant values cannot be booleans, so these carry unchecked/checked, off/on, no/yes, collapsed/expanded. The NAME is Category A and diffable; the VALUES are not. Recorded, not forced to true/false.
indeterminate is a SEPARATE boolean prop in MUI, not a third value of checked. Figma models three mutually exclusive states. Recorded per instruction, not restructured.
MUI PaginationItem type accepts start-ellipsis and end-ellipsis; there is no plain 'ellipsis'. Figma collapses both into one value.

invalidOrUnthemedValues.detail: Valid MUI value and used in 1 production file, but ChipOverrides defines NO colorSecondary slot, so it renders raw MUI palette.secondary. Valid but unthemed.

The code's accepted set is 8 values, not 7. ChipOverrides styles colorBeta, palette.beta is defined (#B4EBF4 pneumo / #83CDD9 placebo), and color="beta" is used in admin-ui and composition-ui plus 3 stories. Figma has no beta.
invalidOrUnthemedValues.action: GAP - needs a new variant, out of scope for a rename pass

restructureNotRename.figmaShape: One Variant axis folding Elevation 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 / 8 and Outlined together, plus square.
restructureNotRename.codeShape: Two independent props: numeric elevation (0-24) and variant ('elevation' | 'outlined').
restructureNotRename.extra: Production uses elevation 0,1,2,3,4 - and Figma has no Elevation 3 at all.
restructureNotRename.verdict: SPLIT, NOT A RENAME. Out of scope.

restructureNotRename.codeShape: Same two values - Card does NOT have Paper's fold problem. Renamed cleanly.
restructureNotRename.extra: Card is separately missing the raised and square props and a numeric elevation; that is a gap, not a restructure.
